about: Azariah, one of the Israelites who came with Menelik, answers the queen’s call by praising her wisdom and her country. He says that his people long held themselves chosen, but that Ethiopia is better than Judah, and that the dark faces of its people are its one blemish, though if God lights up their hearts none will find them strange (?). He then bids them keep from what God hates and recites the laws he promises to teach: honesty about a neighbour’s goods and strayed animals, justice for the poor, orphan and stranger, care for birds and gleanings, and the curses of Deuteronomy 27, with a warning against images and idols. He cites Psalm 125:3 (the rod of sinners on the lot of the righteous), gives a saying on teaching others the good, and closes with a precept against usury.

sentences.i: And Azariah arose and said to the queen, ‘O our lady, truly there is no one like you in wisdom and knowledge, and it was given to you from God, except my lord the king, who brought us into this land together with our lady Zion, the holy and heavenly one, the ark of God’s law.
sentences.n: ወተንሥአ ‘and he arose’ (ወ- + ተንሥአ, 3ms perfect) and ወይቤላ ‘and he said to her’ (ይቤ + ላ); the addressee is then repeated, ለንግሥት, the doubling Geʿez likes. ኦእግዝእትነ is ኦ (vocative) + እግዝእት ‘lady’ + -ነ ‘our’. አልቦ ‘there is not’ is the standard ‘no one/nothing’; ዘይትማሰለኪ is ዘ- ‘who’ + the ተማ- stem of መሰለ (ተማሰለ, ‘be like, be compared with’; 3ms imperfect) + -ኪ ‘you (f)’; አእምሮ is ‘knowledge’, kept apart from ልቡና ‘understanding’ as in ch. 89. ተውህበ is the passive of ወሀበ ‘give’. ዘእንበለ ‘except, apart from’ (recurs often), here qualifying the whole claim: no one equals you except the king. ዘአብጽሐነ is ዘ- + causative አብጽሐ ‘bring’ (from በጽሐ ‘arrive’) + -ነ ‘us’. The last chain is apposition: ጽዮን, then ቅድስት ‘holy’, ሰማያዊት ‘heavenly’, then ታቦተ ሕጉ ‘ark of his law’ (construct state, -ተ ending, as ታቦተ ኪዳኑ later). Azariah’s speech opens here and runs to the end of the part.

sentences.i: As for us and our fathers of old, we used to say that God chose no one except the house of Jacob. Us he chose, us he multiplied, us he favoured; he made us kings and made us the people of his house and his counsellors, for his glory and for the ark of his covenant. And of the country, too, we say that he chose none other than our country;
sentences.n: ንሕነሰ ‘as for us’: ንሕነ ‘we’ + the contrastive -ሰ (this -ሰ recurs: ወይእዜሰ, ለእመሰ). ንቤ is the 1cp of ይቤ ‘say’, ‘we said/used to say’ (I read it as a habitual past). ዘኀረየ is ዘ- + ኀረየ ‘choose’. The object pronoun ኪያነ ‘us’ is fronted three times (ኪያነ ኀረየ… ወኪያነ አብዝኀ… ወኪያነ ሠምረ) for emphasis: ‘us he chose’. አንገሠነ is the causative of ነግሠ ‘reign’, so ‘made us kings’; ወረሰየነ is ረሰየ ‘make, set’ + -ነ. ቤተ ያዕቆብ, ሰብአ ቤቱ ‘people of his house’ (ch. 88’s rendering), ታቦተ ኪዳኑ are construct chains; መማክርቲሁ is ‘his counsellors’ (plural + -ሁ). ወሀገርኒ: ሀገር + the additive -ኒ ‘also’. The claim of election for ‘the house of Jacob’ is the Israelite party’s own; the next unit turns it to Ethiopia.

sentences.n: ወይእዜሰ ‘and now, indeed’ (ይእዜ ‘now’ + -ሰ). ርኢነ is ርእየ ‘see’, 1cp perfect. እንተ ትኄይስ ‘which is better’: እንተ is the feminine relative (agreeing with ሀገረ), ትኄይስ the 3fs imperfect of ኀየሰ ‘be good, be better’, with እም- ‘than’ for the comparison: እምብሔረ ይሁዳ ‘than the land of Judah’. ሀገረ ኢትዮጵያ is the accusative/construct, in apposition to the unexpressed object of ‘we saw’.

sentences.i: And when we reached your land, everything we saw pleased us. Your water, too, is good, and you give it without price; and the air is without መረዋሕት (?) and ጸቃውዕ (?), like the ጽንጒነ (?) of the open plain, and the livestock are like the sand of the sea. Of all we saw there was nothing defective (?) and no affliction (?), in what we heard, in what we trod on (?), in what we touched, and in what we tasted with our mouths;
sentences.n: A catalogue of the land’s praise. ወእምከመ ‘and when’; በጻሕነ is በጽሐ ‘arrive’ (1cp perfect); ሠነየነ is ሠነየ ‘be good, please’ + -ነ ‘us’. ማይክሙኒ is ማይ ‘water’ + -ክሙ ‘your’ + -ኒ ‘too’. ትሁቡ I take as 2mp imperfect of ወሀበ (‘you give’); ዘእንበለ ሤጥ ‘without price’. CRUX: መረዋሕት, ጸቃውዕ and ጽንጒነ are words I cannot fix without Dillmann (the sentence seems to praise air and abundance, ‘like the … of the open plain’; መርሕብ is ‘broad place’), so they are left untranslated and marked (?). ሕሱመ ‘defective’ and ፀዋገ ‘affliction’ are also uncertain (?): parts 49–50 and 81 give ፀዋግ as ‘captor (?)’ and ‘grim (?)’, so ‘affliction’ here is only a guess from its pairing with ሕሱመ; ሕሱመ may be the same word as ሕሡመ in the curse on the deaf below (ሰ/ሠ). ንከይድ is ከይደ ‘tread, go’ (?), the senses then being hearing, treading, touch, taste (sight is ርኢነ); I do not find a verb of smelling in the form, though the order of the senses (sight, hearing, ?, touch, taste) would put smell at this place (?). The word printed ን ፡ ገስስ (with a stray ፡ inside; kept as printed) is ንገስስ, 1cp imperfect of ገሰሰ ‘touch, feel’. The repeated እምዘ ‘of what’ (እም- + ዘ) ties the four senses together.

sentences.i: But among all that meets the eye one thing remains: that you are dark of face. What I say, I say from what I have seen. But if God lights up your hearts, there will be no one who finds you strange, or does you harm (?).
sentences.n: A delicate turn, said with care. እምእንተ ትኔጽር አሐቲ ሀለወት ‘from (among) what one looks at, one (thing) there is’ (ትኔጽር 3fs/impersonal imperfect of ነጸረ ‘look’; I read it as ‘of all that is seen’). ኮንክሙ is ኮነ in the 2mp perfect (-ክሙ ‘you’, as the glossary has it), ‘you are, have become’; ጸሊማነ ‘dark’ is the plural predicate; በገጽ ‘in face’ (በ- ‘in’). ዘእቤ is ዘ- + 1cs imperfect ‘I say’; በዘ ርኢኩ ‘by what I saw’. ለእመ ‘if’ (recurs, also ለእመሰ); አብርሀ is the causative of በርሀ ‘shine’ (‘illumine’), cf. Ephesians 1:18 (hearts enlightened) (?). ዘይነኪየክሙ is ዘ- + a 3ms imperfect + -ክሙ ‘you’; its last radical is -y, not the -r of ነኪር ‘strange, foreign’, so the link with ነኪር is doubtful: ‘finds you strange’ is a guess, and a different root, perhaps ‘harm’, is possible (?).

sentences.i: But turn aside from the dead (?), from blood, from cutting (?), and from fornication, and from everything that God hates, so that we may rejoice in you when we see you fearing God and trembling at his word;
sentences.n: ተገሐሡ is the imperative (2mp) of ተገሐሠ ‘turn aside’ (the house rendering of chs. 88–89; with እም- ‘from’, ‘turn aside from’, i.e. keep away from); the prohibitive of the same verb, ኢትትገሐሡ, comes in the next sentence but one, and ተገሐሥ/ይትገሐሡ again later. እማውታ I read as እም- ‘from’ + ማውታ ‘the dead’ (the same word is in እጓለ ማውታ ‘orphan’, below: ‘child of the dead’). Beside ‘blood’ and ‘fornication’ the list may recall Acts 15:20 (?), which would make እማውታ ‘what has died of itself’ (?). ብትክ I take as ‘cutting’ (from በተከ ‘cut off’), perhaps the gashing forbidden in Leviticus 19:28 (?). ዘይጸልእ ‘what hates’: ዘ- + ጸልአ. ከመ ንትፈሣሕ ‘so that we rejoice’: ከመ + the 1cp subjunctive. ሶበ ‘when’ (also ‘if’); እንዘ + imperfect gives ‘while’ (እንዘ ትፈርሁ ‘while you fear’). ትርዕዲ has the ending -ዲ (2fs), but the sense is plural, ‘you tremble’ (ርዕደ): a slip for ትርዕዱ or a collapsed ending (?).

sentences.i: and do not turn aside, to the right or to the left, from what we command you today. And now serve God, the Holy One of Israel, and do his will; for he has rejected our people, as our prophets foretold, and has chosen you.
sentences.n: ወኢትትገሐሡ ‘and do not turn aside’: ኢ- + 2mp imperfect; ኢለየማን ወኢለፀጋም ‘neither to the right nor to the left’ (ኢ + ለ-, the pairs recur), the phrase of Deuteronomy 5:32 and 28:14. ንኤዝዘክሙ ‘we command you’ (a form of አዘዘ, 1cp + -ክሙ); ዮም ‘today’. ወይእዜኒ ‘and now’. ከመ ታምልክዎ ‘that you serve him’ (አምለከ ‘worship, serve’); ቅዱሰ እስራኤል ‘Holy One of Israel’ is the title of Isaiah. ሥምረቶ ‘his good pleasure, will’ (from ሠምረ, as in ወኪያነ ሠምረ above). CRUX of sense: መነኖሙ ለሕዝብነ is መነነ ‘reject, spurn’ + -ሙ + ለ- ‘our people’, the Israelite speaker saying that God has rejected his own people (Judah), as ‘our prophets’ (ነቢያቲነ) foretold; I take ኪያክሙ ‘you’ as the Ethiopians, fronted as ኪያነ was before. The sentence ends at ፤.

sentences.i: Is not God the creator of all of you? What is too hard for God, if he loved us and hated them? For everything is his and everything is his handiwork; and nothing is too hard for God, the God of Israel.
sentences.n: አኮኑ is አኮ ‘not’ + the question particle -ኑ, ‘is it not (so)’. ፈጣሪክሙ ‘your creator’ (ፈጣሪ + -ክሙ); ኵልክሙ ‘all of you’ (ኵል + -ክሙ). ይሰአኖ is ሰአነ ‘be unable, be hard’ + -ኖ ‘to him’: ‘what is too hard for him’ (?), the rhetorical question of Genesis 18:14; I render it ‘what is too hard for’, as in the last clause of the unit. ለእመ አፍቀረ ኪያነ ወጸልአ ኪያሆሙ ‘if he loved us and hated them’ echoes Malachi 1:2-3 (‘Jacob I loved, Esau I hated’). ተግባር is ‘work, creature’; ሎቱ ‘to him, his’. The doubled ‘to God’ (ለእግዚኣብሔር) is the usual Geʿez restatement of the subject.

sentences.n: The numeral ፩ is a word on its own (the build gives it role ‘num’). ኢይትኀየል ‘let him not prevail against’ (ተኀየለ ‘be strong’), ካልኦ ‘another’. ኢትሂዲ is a singular-looking prohibitive of a verb I cannot place with confidence (ሄደ ‘go’? ‘take away’?) (?). The three plural prohibitions ኢትትሓመዩ, ኢትትዓመፁ, ኢትትላኰዩ are in the reciprocal ተ- stem (‘to one another’): ተዓመፀ is from ዐመፀ ‘do wrong’; ተሓመየ and ተላኰየ I cannot fix (?): ‘injure’ for ኢትትሓመዩ is only a guess, and ተላኰዩ is left untranslated. ንዋየ ቢጽክሙ: ንዋይ ‘goods’ in the construct state, ቢጽ ‘neighbour, fellow’ + -ክሙ. sentences.n: Leviticus 19:9-10, 23:22; Deuteronomy 24:19-21 (the gleanings for the stranger, orphan and widow). ተዐጽዲ has the 2fs ending -ዲ but a plural sense (cf. ትርዕዲ above): ‘you reap’ (ዐጸደ). ዐጺደ is the verbal noun ‘reaping’ in the accusative, ‘as to reaping’. ማእረረ እክልክሙ ‘the harvest of your grain’ (construct). ኢትጠናቀቁ is a 2mp prohibitive of a quadriradical related to ጠነቀቀ ‘be careful, exact’ (not a ተ-stem, since only the one ት of the prefix stands before the stem; the long ና is unexplained); the stem and the meaning are my reading (?). ኢትእርዩ ‘do not pick up/gather’ (?); ዘረሳዕክሙ ‘what you forgot’ (ረሰዐ), ክልስስት ‘sheaf’ (?); ተመዪጠክሙ ‘your turning back’ (the verbal noun of ተመይጠ + -ክሙ, or a 2mp perfect ‘you turned back’; the spelling with ዪ is unexplained) (?). ለግዩረ ሀገርክሙ ‘for the stranger of your country’; ግዩር ‘stranger, alien’ returns in a later curse.

sentences.i: And do not do anything unclean, and do not judge with partiality, and do not do injustice in anything you speak of, so that you may be blessed, and the fruit of your land may increase, and you may be saved from the curse of the law which God commanded, that they should curse the doer of evil. And he wrote, saying: Whoever leads the blind astray from his way is cursed;
sentences.n: The long unit (32 words) that leads into the curses is kept whole because its only ፤ is at its end. ርኩስ ‘uncleanness’, በአድልዎ ‘with partiality’, ዐመፃ ‘injustice, wrong’. Three purpose clauses with ከመ + subjunctive (ትትባረኩ, ይብዛኅ, ትድኀኑ). እመርገመ ሕግ ‘from the curse of the law’ (እም + መርገም, construct). ከመ ይርግምዎ ‘that they curse (him)’, an indefinite plural, with ለገባሬ እኪት ‘the doer of evil’; ወጸሐፈ ‘and he wrote’ (the subject is not named: God, the last subject, or Moses (?)). The curses are those of Deuteronomy 27:15-26, each with the formula ርጉም ውእቱ ‘cursed is he’ (ርጉም ‘cursed’ + the pronoun ውእቱ), which repeats below with ዘ- + verb as the subject. This first one is Deuteronomy 27:18 (the blind): ዘያስሕቶ is ዘ- + the causative of ስሕተ ‘err’ + -ሁ ‘him’ (the blind man, named again by ለዕዉር); ፍኖቶ ‘his way’, ዕዉር ‘blind’.

sentences.l: And-all who makes carving-his and-casting-his which unclean work-of hands-of man and-sets-it and-hides-it in house-his and-bows to-him as god, not-believing that God maker-of heavens and-earth who-made-him to-Adam in-what his-own image and-likeness and-set-him over all that he-created and-all-of-us creatures-his we, this who not-believes cursed let-be, Amen;
sentences.i: And everyone who makes a carved image or a cast image, an unclean work of human hands, and sets it up and hides it in his house and bows down to it as a god, not believing that God is the maker of heaven and earth, who made Adam in his own image and likeness and set him over all he created, and that we are all his creatures: whoever does not believe this, let him be cursed. Amen;
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 27:15 (the carved or cast image, ‘an abomination, the work of the hands of a craftsman’), widened with the creed of Genesis 1:26-28 and Psalm 8:6. ግልፎ ‘his carving’ (ግልፍ + -ሁ) and ስብኮ ‘his casting’ (ስብክ), the -ሁ standing for a possessive that English leaves out; ዘርኩስ ‘which is unclean’. ይሠይሞ is ሠየመ ‘set up, appoint’ + -ሁ; የኀብኦ ‘hides it’ (ኀብአ); ይሰግድ ሎቱ ‘bows down to him/it’. ኢአሚኖ is a negated participle ‘not believing’, with ከመ ‘that’. ዘገብሮ ለአዳም ‘who made Adam’ (ገብሮ = ገብረ + -ሁ) በዘ ዚአሁ አርአያ ወአምሳል ‘in his own image and likeness’ (ዘ ዚአሁ ‘of his own’), the Genesis 1:26 pair, noted in the pilot chapter too. ወሤሞ ‘and set him’ (ሠየመ + -ሁ). ተግባር ‘work, handiwork’. Then the oath of the curse: ዘንተ ዘኢየአምን ‘this one who does not believe’, ርጉመ ለይኩን ‘let him be cursed’ (ለይኩን the jussive ‘let him be’); አሜን is Amen, the people’s response in Deuteronomy 27:15. At 40 words it is under the cut limit and kept whole.

sentences.i: Whoever kills an innocent person wrongfully and in secret, let him be cursed. And above all, do not serve other gods, for God is jealous toward those who disregard (?) him and do so; he sets his face against them until he uproots their life from the earth and blots out their memory forever.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 27:24-25 for the first curse (‘in secret’ is the በጒሕሉት of the curse above). ዘይቀትል ነፍሰ ደመ ንጹሐ: ነፍሰ ‘a person/soul’ then ደመ ንጹሐ ‘of innocent blood’, as I read it (?). Then the commandment of Exodus 20:3-5 and Deuteronomy 6:14-15: ወእምኵሉሰ ‘above all’ (እም + ኵሉ + -ሰ), ኢታምልኩ ‘do not serve’ (the same አምለከ as in ከመ ታምልክዎ above), ባዕደ አማልክተ ‘other gods’; ቀናኢ ‘jealous’. ለእለ ይትዔወርዎ ‘toward those who disregard him’ (ተዐወረ again, ‘turn a blind eye to’, here with God as object) (?). ያቀውም ገጾ ላዕሌሆሙ ‘sets his face against them’ is Leviticus 17:10 and 20:3; ይሤርዎሙ is ሠረወ ‘uproot’ + -ሙ with ሕይወቶሙ ‘their life’ in apposition; ወያጠፍእ ዝክሮሙ ‘and blots out their memory’ (cf. sentences.n: A saying in the manner of the Gospel parables (Luke 19:8 for ‘fourfold’ (?); ‘he did and taught’ resembles Matthew 5:19 (?)), not a direct quotation. ተክህ ሎ ‘it was possible for him’ (ተክህለ ‘be able’, impersonal) ለብእሲ ‘for a man’; ለሊሁኒ ‘he himself too’ (ለሊሁ + -ኒ), ለቢጹኒ ‘and to his neighbour too’. ባዕለ ክልኤ መካልይ ‘owner of two measures’ (the construct state again; ‘measures’ for መካልይ is my guess (?)); ይትወሰኮ is the passive of ወሰከ ‘add’ + -ኦ ‘to him’. ትርብዕተ ‘fourfold’ (?), ዐስቡ ‘his reward’ (ዐስብ + -ሁ). sentences.i: And again, you will be blessed if you give your goods without interest or demand for repayment (?). ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.n: The closing precept is the law against usury (Exodus 22:25, Leviticus 25:36-37, Deuteronomy 23:19-20, Psalm 15:5). ወካዕበ ‘and again’; ብፁዓን ትከውኑ ‘you will be blessed’ (the plural predicate with ትከውኑ ‘you will be’). ወሀብክሙ is the 2mp perfect ‘you give’ (with ለእመ ‘if’). ዘእንበለ ርዴ ወልቃሕ ‘without ርዴ and ልቃሕ’: I take ርዴ as ‘interest, increase’ and ልቃሕ as ‘taking back, loan-claim’ (?), uncertain without Dillmann. The five ፨ at the end close the chapter and belong to this last unit.

glossary.ትነግርዎ: ነገረ — you tell him (2mp subjunctive, G + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ትኔጽር: ነጸረ — one looks at, it meets the eye (3fs / impersonal imperfect, G, n-ṣ-r; relative clause with እንተ)
glossary.ትእዛዞ: ትእዛዝ — his command (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', anticipating ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the command of God') · his commandment, as a plain object with no owner named after it (ዐቀብከ ትእዛዞ 'you have kept his commandment')
glossary.ትከውኑ: ኮነ — you (mp) are, will be (2mp imperfect, k-w-n)
glossary.ትድኀኑ: ድኅነ — that you be saved (2mp subjunctive, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ትፈርሁ: ፈርሀ — you fear (2mp imperfect, G, f-r-h)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ነቢያቲነ: ነቢይ — our prophets (noun, plural ነቢያት, stem ነቢያቲ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ነፍሰ: ነፍስ — soul, life, person (noun, accusative) · construct 'soul of' (ነፍሰ ዳዊት 'the soul of David')
glossary.ን: እብን — -ን, second half of በአእባን 'with stones', split off by a stray wordspace · also the first half of ን ፡ ገስስ 'we touch' (ንገስስ), split by a stray wordspace (the second half is ገስስ)
glossary.ንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — as for us (1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ንሬኢየክሙ: ርእየ — we see you (1cp imperfect, G, r-ʾ-y + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ንሰምዕ: ሰምዐ — we hear (1cp imperfect, G, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ንቤ: ብህለ — we said (1cp perfect ንቤ of the defective ይቤ, ትቤ, ንቤ; b-h-l)
glossary.ንትፈሣሕ: ተፈሥሐ — that we rejoice (1cp subjunctive, tä-stem, f-ś-ḥ)
glossary.ንኤዝዘክሙ: አዘዘ — we command you (1cp imperfect, G + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ንከይድ: ከይደ — we tread, go (?) (1cp imperfect, G, k-y-d; sense guessed from the list of senses; the order of the senses, sight, hearing, ?, touch, taste, would put 'smell' here, but I cannot confirm that sense for ከይደ) (?)
glossary.ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
glossary.ንዋዮ: ንዋይ — his goods, property (noun, accusative + -ሁ '3ms his', ንዋዮ)
glossary.ንጥዕም: ጠዐመ — we taste (1cp imperfect, G, ṭ-ʿ-m)
glossary.ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
glossary.አልባቢክሙ: ልብ — your hearts (noun, plural አልባብ, stem አልባቢ- + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አምላክ: አምላክ — God, god (noun, singular; here 'a God') · 'god' in ዘእምአምላክ 'that is from god' (no article)
glossary.አርአያ: አርአያ — image, likeness · 'vision, appearance' (ዘከመዝ አርአያ ዘርኢከ 'such a vision as you saw', ch. 56)
glossary.አብርሀ: አብርሀ — he lit up, illumined (3ms perfect, causative of በርሀ 'shine')
glossary.አብዝኀ: አብዝኀ — he multiplied, made many (3ms perfect, causative of በዝኀ)
glossary.አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.አዘዞሙ: አዘዘ — he commanded them (3ms perfect, G + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
glossary.አዝዞሙ: አዘዘ — command them! (2ms imperative, G, addressed to Moses, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.አግብኡ: አግብአ — they brought in, brought to (3m pl perfect, causative of ገብአ 'enter, return')
glossary.አጽንዑ: አጽንዐ — keep, hold fast! (2mp imperative, causative of ጸንዐ 'be firm')
glossary.አፍኅርቲሃ: አፍኅርት — her fledglings (?) (noun, plural, stem አፍኅርቲ- + -ሃ '3fs her'; sense and lemma form uncertain) (?)
glossary.ኢለየማን: የማን — not to the right (ኢ- + ለ- + noun 'right hand, right')
glossary.ኢታምልኩ: አምለከ — do not serve (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive; 'serve, worship', from አምላክ)
glossary.ኢትርክቦሙ: ረከበ — that it not reach them (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs subjunctive, G, r-k-b + -ሙ '3mp them'; the subject presumably መቅሠፍት 'scourge')
glossary.ኢትትዐወርዎ: ተዐወረ — do not turn a blind eye to it (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, tä-stem + -ዎ '3ms it, him')
glossary.ኢትትዐደዉ: ተዐደወ — do not pass by (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, tä-stem of ዐደወ 'cross, pass over')
glossary.ኢትኅልፉ: ኀለፈ — do not pass by (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, G, ḫ-l-f)
glossary.ኢትንሥኡ: ነሥአ — do not take (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ኢትእርዩ: እርየ — do not gather (?) (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive; root, lemma form and sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ኢትዘበጥ: ዘበጠ — lest you be struck (ኢ- 'not' + 2ms jussive with passive sense; the passive ተ- prefix is not visible; perhaps ኢትትዘበጥ with one ት dropped (?)) (?)
glossary.ኢትጠናቀቁ: ጠናቀቀ — do not be too exacting (?) (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive of a quadriradical related to ጠነቀቀ 'be careful, exact'; it is not a ተ-stem, since only the one ት of the 2mp prefix stands before the stem, and the long ና is unexplained; stem and meaning are my reading) (?)
glossary.ኢአሚኖ: አመነ — not believing (ኢ- 'not' + a verbal form of አመነ 'believe', probably the gerund አሚኖ 'believing', formed like ነጊሮ from ነገረ; the exact form is not certain) (?)
glossary.ኢየኀድግ: ኀደገ — he does not leave (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-d-g); with the speaker's own 'I' as sense, 'I will not leave' (?)
glossary.ኢያንሥኡ: አንሥአ — that they not lift up (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp subjunctive, causative of ነሥአ)
glossary.ኢያእመርክሙ: አእመረ — you do not know (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp perfect of አእመረ, ኢ- before አ- written ኢያ-; used as a present, 'if you do not know')
glossary.ኢይትኀየል: ተኀየለ — that he/I not take by force (neg. ኢ- + jussive, tä-stem, 'be overpowered, take by force'); form 3ms though the sense is the speaker's
glossary.ኢይኅድግ: ኀደገ — let him not leave (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.እመርገመ: መርገም — from the curse of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
glossary.እማውታ: ሙት — from the dead (?) (እም- 'from' + plural ማውታ 'the dead'; beside 'blood' and 'fornication' perhaps 'what has died of itself' (?); sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.እምቃሉ: ቃል — from his word (እም- 'from' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.እምብሔረ: ብሔር — from the land of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምንዋየ: ንዋይ — from the goods of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምእለ: እለ — more than those who (እም- comparative + relative pronoun) · from among those who, of those who (እም- partitive; ፩ እምእለ ይቴሐቱ 'one of those who are humbled')
glossary.እምእንተ: እንተ — from among what, of what (እም- 'from, of' + feminine relative pronoun)
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you') · 'since' of time (እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed') · 'in respect of what' (እምዘ ንሰምዕ 'in what we hear')
glossary.እምድር: ምድር — from the earth (እም- + ምድር, the doubled ም written once; the Hebrew of 1 Samuel 2:8 has 'dust', this text does not)
glossary.እምፍኖተ: ፍኖት — from the way of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct state)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እንግርክሙ: ነገረ — that I tell you, let me tell you (1cs subjunctive, G + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.እኪት: እኩይ — evil, wicked (adjective, fem. እኪት; masc. እኩይ)
glossary.እግዚእየ: እግዚእ — my lord (noun + -የ '1cs my') · vocative 'my lord' (ብቊዐኒ እግዚእየ) · in apposition, 'David, my lord' (አቡየ ዳዊት እግዚእየ)
glossary.እጐልተ: እጐልት — kid, young animal (noun, fem.; accusative)
glossary.ኦእግዝእትነ: እግዝእት — O our lady (ኦ vocative particle + noun, fem. + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኪያሃ: ኪያሃ — her (accusative independent pronoun, 3fs; object of ያኀድጉነ) · object of አማሰኑ 'they destroyed her' (the city)
glossary.ኪያክሙ: ኪያ — you (accusative particle ኪያ- + -ክሙ '2mp you'; the object fronted for emphasis)
glossary.ካልኦ: ካልእ — another, one another (adjective used as noun; probably accusative ካልአ + -ሁ '3ms his', written -ኦ, as ንዋዮ, ቢጾ: 'his other', the idiom ፩ … ካልኦ 'one … another'; cf. ካልኡ in chs. 23, 53) (?)
glossary.ክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the short form ክልኤ before a noun)
glossary.ክሙ: -ክሙ — your (2mp suffix; the second half of ዘርእ ፡ ክሙ 'your seed', split by a stray wordspace)
glossary.ኮንከ: ኮነ — you are (2ms perfect, G, k-w-n, ending -ከ)
glossary.ኮንክሙ: ኮነ — you became (2mp perfect, G, k-w-n, ending -ክሙ)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወሀብክሙ: ወሀበ — you give (2mp perfect, G, w-h-b, ending -ክሙ; 'if you give')
glossary.ወሀገርኒ: ሀገር — and as for the country (ወ- 'and' + noun + additive enclitic -ኒ 'also, too')
glossary.ወለሀገራ: ሀገር — and her country (ወ- 'and' + ለ- marking the object + noun + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ራ)
glossary.ወለስምዐ: ስምዕ — and for the witness of (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'for' + noun, construct)
glossary.ወለቢጹኒ: ቢጽ — and to his neighbour too (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'to' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his' + enclitic -ኒ 'too')
glossary.ወለታቦተ: ታቦት — and for the ark of (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'for' + noun, construct 'ark of')
glossary.ወለእመሰ: እመ — and if indeed, but if (ወ- + ለእመ + enclitic -ሰ contrastive)
glossary.ወለእመቦ: እመ — and if there is (ወ- + ለእመ conditional + ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወለእመኒቦ: እመ — and if there is anyone (ወ- 'and' + ለእመ conditional + -ኒ + ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወልቃሕ: ልቃሕ — and demand for repayment (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወመህረ: መሀረ — and he taught (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, m-h-r)
glossary.ወመማክርቲሁ: መምከር — and his counsellors (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun, plural መማክርት, stem መማክርቲ- + -ሁ '3ms his'; the singular lemma form is my reconstruction) (?)
glossary.ወሤሞ: ሤመ — and he appointed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, ś-y-m + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወሥርዐትየ: ሥርዐት — and my ordinance (ወ- 'and' + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወረሰየነ: ረሰየ — and he made us, set us as (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, r-s-y + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወስምዑ: ሰምዐ — hear, listen (2mp imperative, G stem; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወስብኮ: ስብክ — and his cast image (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወሶበ: ሶበ — and when (ወ- + conjunction) · and Sobo (ወ- + proper name ሶበ, in the list of lands ruled by the Ishmaelites, ወሶበ ወኵርጒ; unidentified) (?)
glossary.ወበአእምሮ: አእምሮ — and in knowledge, understanding (ወ- + በ- + noun, verbal noun of አእመረ)
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወበጒሕሉት: ጒሕሉት — and in secret (?) (ወ- 'and' + በ- 'in' + noun)
glossary.ወብትክ: ብትክ — ? (?) unknown (ወ- + noun), perhaps 'cutting off' (cf. በተከ)
glossary.ወብፁዓን: ብፁዕ — and blessed ones (ወ- 'and' + adjective used as noun, plural ብፁዓን)
glossary.ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተውህበ: ወሀበ — and it was given (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ወሀበ)
glossary.ወተድባብ: ተድባብ — and parapet (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun; 'roof, parapet, canopy', sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወታስተላዕልዎ: አስተላዕለ — and you lift it (ወ- 'and' + 2mp subjunctive, አስተ- causative of the tä-stem ተላዕለ, from ላዕለ 'be high' + -ዎ '3ms it')
glossary.ወታቅልሉ: አቅለለ — and lighten (ወ- 'and' + 2mp subjunctive, causative of ቀለለ 'be light')
glossary.ወትሁቡ: ወሀበ — and you give (ወ- 'and' + 2mp imperfect, G, w-h-b)
glossary.ወትግበሩ: ገብረ — and do (ወ- 'and' + 2mp jussive, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወኀረየ: ኀረየ — and he chose (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, ḫ-r-y)
glossary.ወንግሮሙ: ነገረ — and tell them! (ወ- 'and' + 2ms imperative, G, addressed to Moses, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአበዊነ: አብ — and our fathers (ወ- 'and' + plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ወአንገሠነ: አንገሠ — and he made us kings (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative of ነግሠ 'reign' + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወኢለፀጋም: ፀጋም — and not to the left (ወ- + ኢ- + ለ- + noun 'left')
glossary.ወኢታብስሉ: አብሰለ — and do not boil (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, causative 'cook')
glossary.ወኢታድልዉ: አድለወ — and do not show partiality (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, causative, d-l-w)
glossary.ወኢትሂዲ: ሄደ — and do not carry off (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, G, written with the ending -ዲ as in ትርዕዲ, ተዐጽዲ; the verb is ሄደ 'go' as in chs. 43, 81, but 'carry off' is only a guess from the context) (?)
glossary.ወኢትትላኰዩ: ተላኰየ — and do not ተላኰዩ (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, reciprocal tä-stem; root and sense unknown, left untranslated) (?)
glossary.ወኢትትሓመዩ: ተሓመየ — and do not injure one another (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, reciprocal tä-stem; root uncertain, 'injure' only a guess) (?)
glossary.ወኢትትኀለፉ: ተኀለፈ — and do not go by (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, tä-stem of ኀለፈ 'pass')
glossary.ወኢትትዓመፁ: ተዓመፀ — and do not wrong one another (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp jussive, reciprocal tä-stem of ዐመፀ)
glossary.ወኢትትገሐሡ: ተግሕሠ — and do not turn aside (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, tä-stem; cf. ተገሐሡ, ኢትትገሐሥ in chs. 88-89)
glossary.ወኢትንሥኡ: ነሥአ — and do not take (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወኢትግምጹ: ገምጸ — and do not pervert (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, G, g-m-ṣ)
glossary.ወኢትግበሩ: ገብረ — and do not do (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወኢትፍትሑ: ፈትሐ — and do not judge (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp prohibitive, G, f-t-ḥ)
glossary.ወእመቦ: እመ — and if there is (ወ- 'and' + conditional እመ + ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወእመኒቦ: እመ — and if there is anyone (ወ- 'and' + conditional እመ + -ኒ + ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወእምኵሉ: ኵሉ — and from all (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'from' + ኵሉ 'all')
glossary.ወእምኵሉሰ: ኵሉ — and above all (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'more than' + ኵሉ 'all' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወእምዘ: ዘ — and of what, than what (ወ- 'and' + እም- 'of, than' + relative pronoun ዘ)
glossary.ወእንስሳ: እንስሳ — and livestock, animals (ወ- + collective noun, accusative)
glossary.ወእጓለ: እጓል — and child of (ወ- 'and' + noun, construct; with ማውታ 'child of the dead', orphan)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወኪያነ: ኪያ — and us (ወ- 'and' + accusative particle ኪያ- + -ነ '1cp us'; the object fronted for emphasis)
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወኵልነ: ኵሉ — and all of us (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወዘሐነጸ: ሐነጸ — and who built (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, ḥ-n-ṣ)
glossary.ወዘረሳዕክሙ: ረስዐ — and what you forgot (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- relative + 2mp perfect, G, r-s-ʿ, ending -ክሙ; written ረሳዕ- for ረስዕ-, as ወረሳዕነ in ch. 60b)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘአርኰሰ: አርኰሰ — and who defiled (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, causative of ረኰሰ 'be unclean')
glossary.ወዘወድቀሂ: ወድቀ — and what has fallen too (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, w-d-q + enclitic -ሂ 'too, also')
glossary.ወዘይሰክብ: ሰከበ — and who lies with (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, s-k-b)
glossary.ወዘይነግሮ: ነገረ — and who tells him, speaks to him (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G + -ሁ '3ms him', contracted -ሮ)
glossary.ወዘይዘብጥ: ዘበጠ — and who strikes (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, z-b-ṭ)
glossary.ወዘይገምጽ: ገምጸ — and who perverts (ወ- 'and' + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, g-m-ṣ)
glossary.ወየኀብኦ: ኀብአ — and he hides it (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-b-ʾ + -ሁ '3ms it', written -ኦ)
glossary.ወያቀውም: አቀመ — and he sets (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect ያቀውም, causative of ቆመ 'stand')
glossary.ወያጠፍእ: አጠፍአ — and he destroys (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative አ- stem, ṭ-f-ʾ)
glossary.ወይሠይሞ: ሤመ — and he sets it up (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect ይሠይም, G, ś-y-m + -ሁ '3ms it')
glossary.ወይሰግድ: ሰገደ — and he bows down (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect, G, s-g-d)
glossary.ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her') · masculine form where a woman speaks to her sister and ትቤላ is expected (ወይቤላ ዝንቱ ንዋየ አቡነ 'and she said to her: this property of our father') (?)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይትባረኩ: ተባረከ — and may they be blessed (ወ- 'and' + 3mp subjunctive, tä-stem passive of ባረከ)
glossary.ወይትወሰኮ: ወሰከ — and it is added to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms subjunctive, tä-stem passive of ወሰከ 'add' + -ኦ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — and now, as for (ወ- 'and' + adverb 'now' + contrastive enclitic -ሰ 'as for, but')
glossary.ወይከውን: ኮነ — and it will be (ወ- + 3ms imperf., k-w-n)
glossary.ወይገብሩ: ገብረ — and they make (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወደሳ: ወደሰ — he praised her (3ms perfect, G, w-d-s + -ኣ '3fs her'; the ወ is a root letter, not 'and')
glossary.ወጸልአ: ጸልአ — and he hated (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-l-ʾ)
glossary.ወጸቃውዕ: ጸቃውዕ — and ? (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun of unknown sense, left untranslated) (?)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዐዘቅተ: ዐዘቅት — wells, pits (noun, accusative) · singular 'a well' (ዘከረየ ዐዘቅተ 'who dug a well')
glossary.ዐጺደ: ዐጺድ — reaping (verbal noun of ዐጸደ, accusative)
glossary.ዘርኢነ: ርእየ — what we saw, that which we saw (ዘ- + 1cp perfect, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ዘርእ: ዘርእ — seed, offspring (noun, absolute state) · also the first half of ዘርእ ፡ ክሙ 'your seed', split by a stray wordspace (the second half is ክሙ)
glossary.ዘርኩስ: ርኩስ — which is unclean (ዘ- relative + adjective)
glossary.ዘተዐቅብ: ዐቀበ — who keeps (ዘ- relative + 2ms imperfect, G, ʿ-q-b; spelled ተ- where ት- is expected (?))
glossary.ዘትትናገሩ: ተናገረ — what you speak of (ዘ- relative + 2mp imperfect, reciprocal tä-stem of ነገረ 'speak')
glossary.ዘኀረየ: ኀረየ — who chose (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, ḫ-r-y)
glossary.ዘአብጽሐነ: አብጽሐ — who brought us (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, causative of በጽሐ 'arrive' + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ዘአተወ: አተወ — one that came in, entered (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect; አተወ is 'enter' in chs. 13-16, 61, 77, here read as intransitive with እንስሳ beside it, as ዘወድቀ ንዋየ in the next unit; 'one who drove (an animal) in' is the other possible reading) (?)
glossary.ዘአዘዘ: አዘዘ — which he commanded (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.ዘኢየአምን: አመነ — who does not believe (ዘ- relative + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ዘእቤ: ብህለ — which I speak of, say (ዘ- relative + 1s imperfect እቤ, b-h-l)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘከረየ: ከረየ — who dug (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, k-r-y)
glossary.ዘወድቀ: ወድቀ — what fell (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, w-d-q)
glossary.ዘወድቆ: ወድቀ — (that) fell on him (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, w-d-q + -ሁ '3ms him', contracted -ቆ) (?)
glossary.ዘያስሕቶ: አስሐተ — who leads him astray (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect ያስሕት, ʾa-stem causative of ሰሐተ 'err' + -ሁ '3ms him'; lemma as in chs. 64-65, 77)
glossary.ዘያስተአኪ: አስተአከየ — who dishonours (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, አስተ- stem (causative of a tä-stem); root and stem unconfirmed) (?)
glossary.ዘይሰአኖ: ሰአነ — what is too hard for him (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G + -ኖ '3ms for him') (?)
glossary.ዘይቀትል: ቀተለ — who kills (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, q-t-l)
glossary.ዘይትማሰለኪ: ተማሰለ — who resembles you (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of መሰለ + -ኪ '2fs you')
glossary.ዘይነኪየክሙ: ነኪየ — who finds you strange, or does you harm (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect + -ክሙ '2mp you'; the root is uncertain and the link with ነኪር 'strange' doubtful, since the form ends in -y) (?)
glossary.ዘይገብር: ገብረ — who does, who works (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘገብሮ: ገብረ — which made it (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'it')
glossary.ዘጾረ: ጾረ — one who bore, carried (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-w-r)
glossary.ዘፈጠረ: ፈጠረ — what he created (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, f-ṭ-r)
glossary.ይሤርዎሙ: ሠረወ — he will uproot them (3ms imperfect ይሤርው, G, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ይርግምዎ: ረገመ — that they curse him (3mp subjunctive, G, r-g-m + -ዎ '3ms him'; indefinite plural)
glossary.ይሰአኖ: ሰአነ — it is too hard for him (3ms imperfect, G, s-ʾ-n + -ኖ '3ms for him'; sense 'be unable, be hard') (?)
glossary.ይቅትል: ቀተለ — that he kill (3ms subjunctive, G, q-t-l)
glossary.ይባርክ: ባረከ — that he bless (3ms subjunctive, G, b-r-k)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይብዛኅ: በዝኀ — that it increase (3ms subjunctive, G, b-z-ḫ)
glossary.ይትዔወርዎ: ተዐወረ — (those who) disregard him (?) (3mp imperfect, tä-stem + -ዎ '3ms him'; 'turn a blind eye to', here with God as object) (?)
glossary.ይትገሐሡ: ተገሐሠ — they hasten, move about (?) (3mp subjunctive, tä-stem); root and sense uncertain, perhaps related to ገሠሠ 'go about' (?) · 'turn aside' (3mp subjunctive, the same verb as ተግሕሠ, the house rendering of chs. 88-89, 40: ይትገሐሡ እምእለ ይገብሩ እኩየ 'they turn aside from those who do evil')
glossary.ይኑኅ: ኖኅ — that it be long (3ms subjunctive, G, n-w-ḫ)
glossary.ይንግር: ነገረ — let him tell (3ms jussive, G, n-g-r)
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n) · let it be (3ms jussive, here after ዘእንበለ 'except': ዘእንበለ ይኩን ቆዐ ሠርጸ ጽጌ 'except it be that the tendril put forth blossom') (?)
glossary.ይዕቀቡ: ዐቀበ — that they keep (3mp jussive, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ይዕቀብ: ዐቀበ — that he keep (G 3ms subjunctive, ʿ-q-b)
glossary.ይፈደፍድ: ፈደፈደ — he increases, is multiplied (3ms imperfect, quadriradical, f-d-f-d)
glossary.ደቂቃ: ወልድ — her young (plural ደቂቅ + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ቃ)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገስስ: ገሰሰ — we touch (1cp imperfect ንገስስ, G, g-s-s; this is the second half of ን ፡ ገስስ, split by a stray wordspace, with ን before it)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ግዩር: ግዩር — stranger, alien (noun, genitive after the construct ፍትሐ 'judgment of')
glossary.ጸሊማነ: ጸሊም — dark, black (adjective, accusative plural of ጸሊም, nom. ጸሊማን; predicate, with ኮንክሙ)
glossary.ጸድፍ: ጸድፍ — ? (?) unknown, a place into which goods may fall; left untranslated (noun) (?)
glossary.ጽንጒነ: ጽንጒን — ? (?) unknown word, left untranslated (noun, accusative-looking; 'like the ጽንጒነ of the plain') (?)
glossary.ጾረ: ጾር — burden, load (noun, accusative, object of ዘጾረ 'who bore'; from ጾረ 'carry')
glossary.ፀዋገ: ፀዋግ — captor, one who takes captive (noun; accusative; lexical call from context) (?) · 'grim (?)' here, predicate of ኮነ before ከመ ድብ 'like a bear' (ወውእቱሰ ኮነ ፀዋገ 'and he became grim (?)'; one more guess) (?) · 'affliction (?)', paired with ሕሱመ 'defective (?)' (ወአልቦ ፀዋገ 'and no affliction (?)'; a guess from the pairing) (?)
glossary.ፍትሐ: ፍትሕ — judgment, justice (noun, accusative) · construct 'judgment of' (ፍትሐ ሕዝበ አምላከ እስራኤል 'judgment of the people of the God of Israel')
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing')
